response.sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS average_amount FROM account_averages) SELECT a.account_id, a.average_amount, a.average_amount - o.average_amount AS excess FROM account_averages AS a CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE a.average_amount > o.average_amount ORDER BY excess DESC, a.account_id LIMIT 10;
